finding.claim: Managed webhook subscriptions receive every tenant's lifecycle events because delivery never filters by OwnerOperatorID.
finding.source: A non-admin operator holding an admin-minted API key creates a subscription via POST /api/v1/webhook-subscriptions with events=[] (matches all events).
finding.sink: Outbound POST of event payloads (host_id, host_name, network_id, ca_id) to the attacker-controlled URL via store_source.go:44 and webhook.go:231-233.

trace.note: Webhook subscription routes sit behind bearerAuth, not an admin-only group
Only allow_private is admin-gated; subscription creation is not
OwnerOperatorID stored but unused for delivery
Another tenant's block action emits host.blocked
hostEventData includes host_id, host_name, network_id, ca_id
Dispatcher.Emit queues event with no tenant tag
TargetsFor called with only event type
ListActiveWebhookSubscriptions is global, no owner scope
wantsEvent returns true for empty Events (lines 75-77)
Dispatcher with managed Source always constructed

finding.guards_checked: Owner-scoped LIST/GET (api/webhooks.go:38-57) only scopes reads, not delivery. Events emit after each mutation's authz check (hosts.go:349-357). Dispatcher always on (serve.go:146-157). SSRF guard and HMAC do not limit data sent. Requires a non-admin operator with an API key; bearerAuth does not accept UI sessions. Not runtime-verified.

finding.claim: Per-username lockout lets an unauthenticated attacker lock any known local operator, including admins, out of password login for 15 minutes, repeatable indefinitely.
finding.source: Unauthenticated POST /ui/login with a known username and 10 wrong passwords per 15-minute window.
finding.sink: Account lock state set by RecordFailedLoginAttempt (session.go:137), denying login to the protected account.

trace.note: maxFailedLoginAttempts = 10
lockoutDuration = 15m
Per-IP auth rate limit; does not key on account
Generic error for wrong password and locked account
Locked account returns (false,nil) before password check, even when correct
Each wrong password increments counter; lock set at threshold

finding.guards_checked: Dummy bcrypt equalizes timing (session.go:98-117,132). Generic errors prevent enumeration (#180). Lock expires and resets (session.go:119-123). Per-IP limiter applies but 10 attempts per 15 min is under typical limits. Documented trade-off (#263, ASVS V2.1.5). Not verified whether a UI admin-unlock exists.

finding.claim: Delivery SSRF guard omits CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10 (and deprecated fec0::/10). Go's IsPrivate() excludes both, so non-admin subscriptions can reach internal services in that range.
finding.source: Non-admin subscriber sets url resolving into 100.64.0.0/10, e.g. 100.100.100.200 (Alibaba Cloud metadata on deployments hosted there).
finding.sink: Outbound HTTP POST from the server via the guarded client (webhook.go:294-297).

trace.note: ValidateWebhookURL with allowPrivate=false; literal IPs only, DNS names not resolved
AllowPrivate=false passed to Target
Non-AllowPrivate uses guarded client
isBlockedAddr lacks 100.64.0.0/10 check
Dial-time Control hook checks resolved IP; not a DNS-rebinding gap

finding.guards_checked: Dial-time post-resolution check (webhook.go:329-343) defeats DNS rebinding and applies to redirects. IPv4-mapped IPv6 handled via Unmap(). allow_private admin-only (webhooks.go:73). Same predicate duplicated in alerts/sinks.go:136-141 and config/server.go:165-179. Impact depends on deployment.

finding.claim: DeleteCA counts referencing rows in separate queries then deletes without a transaction, so a concurrent network or host insert referencing the CA can commit between count and DELETE, leaving dangling ca_id references.
finding.source: CA owner deletes own CA (web /ui/cas/{id}/delete or API DELETE /api/v1/cas/{id}) while concurrently creating hosts or networks under it.
finding.sink: DELETE FROM cas (sqlite_cas.go:221) without re-checking references.

trace.note: loadAccessibleCA owner gate
COUNT queries run as separate statements
Zero counts pass the check
DELETE outside transaction; concurrent insert can slip in

finding.guards_checked: Owner gate (web/cas.go:318-335, api/authz.go). Host create requires an active owned CA (web/handlers.go:833-843), narrowing the race. Race is owner-with-self, so impact is orphaned rows and 500s on caForHost. Low.
